welcome.subtitle: Executive comfort on Pune–Nagar Road
welcome.message: We're delighted to have you. Explore services, request amenities, or find nearby places — all from your phone.

wifi.title: Wi-Fi & Connectivity
wifi.note: Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi is available throughout the property for staying guests. For security, network access credentials are provided directly at reception upon check-in.

sections.title: Check-in & Check-out
sections.content: Check-in begins at 11:00 AM and check-out is at 10:00 AM. Front desk reception is available 24 hours.

sections.title: Dining
sections.content: Our in-house cloud kitchen serves Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner (Veg & Non-Veg). Meals are delivered directly to your room.

sections.title: Parking
sections.content: Free on-site parking is available 24/7 for all staying guests.

sections.title: Elevator
sections.content: Modern elevator facility providing seamless access throughout the hotel.

sections.title: Pets
sections.content: Hotel Sky Executive is a pet-friendly property. Pets are welcome at no additional charge.

sections.title: Quiet Hours
sections.content: Please maintain quiet hours after 10:00 PM for the comfort of all guests.

sections.title: Payment Methods
sections.content: We accept UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Cash, Credit/Debit Cards, and Bank Transfer.

sections.title: ID Requirement
sections.content: Valid government-issued photo ID is required for all adult guests at check-in.

reception.address: Jaywant Towers, Pune–Nagar Road, near Jaywant Warehouse, Lonikand, Pune – 412216
